title: Find objects left behind by test runs
purpose: Finds groups and administrative units left behind by test runs (names starting with a test marker) in a tenant, and reports the directory roles they hold and who are their members and owners. Read-only: it changes nothing.
whenToRun: After live test runs against a tenant, or on a schedule (-FailIfFound) as a sweep. It looks OUTSIDE PIM's own filters on purpose: test objects carry a marker prefix that PIM's filters never match, so drift checks cannot see them. Cleanup is a separate, deliberate act.

runAs.name: A Microsoft Graph identity already connected in this PowerShell session (PIM's REST context: tenant, application + certificate, or interactive) with Group.Read.All, AdministrativeUnit.Read.All, RoleManagement.Read.Directory and GroupMember.Read.All -- or a Global Reader / Directory Readers user
runAs.why: Lists marker-prefixed groups and administrative units, the directory role assignments, and the members and owners of each group. Read-only; with no tenant context the script scans nothing and says so.

parameters.name: FailIfFound
parameters.help: Exit 3 when anything is found, so a scheduled run surfaces as a failure. Default: exit 0 (report only).

readsOnly: groups whose display name starts with a marker (id, name, created date, role-assignable)
administrative units whose display name starts with a marker
directory role assignments (to report the directory role each found group holds)
members and owners of each found group
whatIf: The script is read-only, so -WhatIf changes nothing about the run: it prints 'What if: this script is read-only ...' and then the same report.
undo: Nothing to undo -- the script changes nothing.
